data.title: Jobcenter invitation for 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a mandatory appointment (Meldeaufforderung) on 22 April 2026 at 8:15 to discuss her current job situation. Bring your CV.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has summoned you to a meeting with Ms Petzold in room 1.18 to talk about your professional situation. Bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss the appointment without an important reason, your Bürgergeld will be reduced by 10% of the standard rate for one month. If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter as early as possible and explain your reason.
